spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (वरयति)
To desire, to obtain, to covet or ask.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Best, excellent.
2 Eldest.
m. (-रः)
1 A boon, a blessing, especially in the gift of a Brahman or deity.
2 Engaging, selecting, appointing.
3 Requesting, soliciting, especially prevailing on a person by intreaty to undertake any business.
4 Surrounding, encompassing.
5 A husband, a bridegroom.
6 A son-in-law.
7 A catamite.
8 A drug: see गुग्गुल.
9 Wish, desire.
10 A sparrow.
n. adv. (वरं) or ind. (वरम)
Better, preferable.
n. (-रं)
Saffron.
f. (-रा)
1 The three myrobalans.
2 A sort of perfume, commonly

Reṇuka.
3

A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
f. (-री)
1 Asparagus racemosus.
2 A name of CHĀYĀ, wife of the sun.
E.
वृ to select, to cover, &c., aff. अप् or अच्; it is also derived from वृ, and is then written with an initial consonant: see वर; also वर to desire, aff. अच्.

m. (-रः)
1 A multitude, a quantity, a flock or herd, a heap.
2 Occasion, opportunity.
3 A day of the week.
4 A moment.
5 A name of Ś

IVA.
6

A door-way, a gate.
7 Achyranthes aspera.
n. (-रं)
A vessel for holding spirituous liquor.
adv.
A time, as वारं वारं many a time, repeatedly, often: see वारम्बारं.
E.
वृ to cover, to choose, &c., aff. घञ्.

n. (-कं)
1 The cover or awning of a boat.
2 A wild kidneybean.
3 A towel, a wiper.
E.
वृ to cover, aff. वुन्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Low, vile, impure.
2 Poor, pitiable.
m. (-कः)
1 Ś

IVA.
2

War.
E.
वृ to cover, &c., षाकन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Opposing, obstructing, an obstacle or agent of resistance.
m. (-कः)
1 A horse's paces.
2 A horse.
n. (-कं)
1 The seat of pain.
2 A sort of fragrant grass: see वाल.
E.
वृ to choose, &c., ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-तुः)
INDRA.
E.
वर best, क्रतु sacrifice.

n. (-नं)
1 A dark sort of Sandal or

Agallochum.
2

A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.)
E.
वर best, चन्दन Sandal.

m. (-टः)
1 A gander.
2 A man of a barbarous or foreign race.
n. (-टं)
Many-flowered jasmine.
f. (-टः-टी)
1 A goose.
2 A wasp, &c.
E.
वृ to choose, aff. अटन्; fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्.

n. (-टः)
1 A cord, a rope.
2 A Cowri: see the next.

n. (-टं)
1 A field.
2 A number of fields.
f. (-टा)
A goose; also वरटा.
E.
वार् water, अट to go, aff. अच्.

n. (-णं)
1 Appointing, selecting, choosing.
2 Surrounding, inclosing.
3 Screening, covering.
4 Nourishing, supporting.
m. (-णः)
1 An outer building, an enclosure, a wall of masonry, &c. raised on a mound of earth.
2 A causeway, a bridge.
3 A camel.
4 A tree, (Capparis trifoliata.)
5 Any tree.
f. (-णा)
A rivulet, running past the north of Benares, into the Ganges, now called the Berṇā.
E.
वृ to choose or appoint, aff. चयु.

INDRA.
2

A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.)
E.
वर best, and णी to obtain, with आङ् prefix, and ड aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Resistance, opposition, prohibition, obstacle or impediment.
2 Defence, protecting, guarding.
3 Warding off a blow, guarding, warding.
m. (-णः)
1 Armour, a cuirass, or mail for the body.
2 An elephant.
E.
वॄ to cover or screen, to defend, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-सी)
The city Benares, more usually वाराणसी.
E.
वरणा a rivulet as above, and असि another running on the south of the city, deriv. irr.

f. (-सी)
Benares.
E.
वर best, अनस् water, ङीप् aff., i. e. the Ganges, on whose bank the city is situated; also वाराणसी and वरणसी.

f. (-सी)
The holy city Benares.
E.
वर best, अनस् water, affs. अण् and ङीष्, i. e. the Ganges on which it stands; also वराणसी.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be applied to or solicited for a boon, &c.
2 To be selected.
E.
वर to ask as a boon, or वृ to choose, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A portico.
2 Pimples on the face.
3 A multitude.
4 A heap of grass.
5 The string of a fish-hook.
6 A packet, a package.
n. (-ण्डा)
A small bird, (Turdus.)
E.
वृञ् to cover, &c., Uṇādi aff. अण्डन्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Fearful, terrified.
2 Large, great.
3 Miserly, a miser.
m. (-कः)
1 A howdah, a chair or canopy on the back of an elephant.
2 A wall.
3 Eruption or pimples on the face.
4 A ball, a globe.
E.
वरण्ड as above, and कन् added.

m. (-लुः)
The castor oil tree, (Ricinus communis.)

f. (-नुः)
An elegant woman.
E.
वर, and तनु body.

f. (-री)
A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā.

f. (-त्रा)
1 An elephant's or horse's leather girth.
2 A thong, a strip of leather.
E.
वृञ् to cover or surround, Uṇādi aff. अत्रन.

n. (-त्रं)
Leather fit for or made into thongs.
E.
वारत्रा a thong, and अण् aff.

m. (-चः)
The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.)
E.
वर best, and त्वच् skin, the final vowel added.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Granting a prayer, conferring a boon.
2 Propitious, favourable.
m. (-दः)
1 A benefactor.
2 Fire for burnt-offerings of a propitiatory character.
f. (-दा)
A girl, a virgin.
E.
वर a blessing, &c., and द who gives.

n. (-नं)
1 Granting a boon.
2 A place of pilgrimage.
E.
वर a blessing, and दान giving.

n. (-नं)
A sort of Mimusops, (M. Kauki, Rox.)
E.
वर best, अदन eating.

m. (-ख्यः)
A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Conferring a boon.
f. (-दा)
The wife of the saint AGASTYA.
E.
वर a boon, and प्रद who gives.

n. (-नं)
Conferring a boon.
E.
वर, and प्रदान giving.

m. (-लः)
The cocoa-nut tree.
E.
वर best, and फल fruit.

f. (-खी)
Reṇukā, a sort of perfume.

ind.
Better, sooner, rather, preferable: see वर.

f. (-रा)
The nux vomica plant.

m. (-ता)
A husband.
E.
वर to choose, in the causal form, aff. तृच्.

m. (-चिः)
A poet and philosopher, one of the ornaments of the court of Bhoja, or one of the nine gems usually ascribed to VIKRAMĀDITYA'S court.
E.
वर pre-eminent, better, रुचि light or renown.

mf. (-लः-ला or -ली)
A wasp.
f. (-ला)
A goose.
E.
वर, and ला to take, aff. क.

f. (-ला)
1 A wasp.
2 A goose.
E.
वार a flock, a flight, ला to get, and क and टाप् aff.; also वरला, &c.

m. (-ब्धः)
A plant, (Mimusops elengi.)

f. (-ला)
The wife of a father-in-law.
E.
वर a bridegroom, and वत्सल affectionate.

f. (-नी)
1 An excellent woman.
2 A virtuous woman.
3 A woman in general.
4

Turmeric.
5

Lāc.
6

A brownish yellow pigment; also रोचना and गोरोहना.
7 A plant, commonly

Priyangu.
8

A name of GAURĪ.
9 SARASVATĪ.
10 LAKṢMĪ.
E.
वर best, बर्ण class or colour, aff. इनि and ङीष्.

m. (-णः)
A fine elephant.
E.
वर, and वारण an elephant.

n. (-कं)
Saffron.
E.
वर, and वाह्लीक the same.

m. (-द्धः)
ŚIVA.
E.
वर better, and वृद्ध old.

n. (-ङ्गं)
1 The head.
2 A privity, a private part, male or female.
3 Cassia bark.
4 An elegant form or body.
m. (-ङ्गः)
An elephant.
E.
वर best, excellent, अङ्ग body or member.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The handle of a sword or knife, &c.
E.
वृ to select, aff. अङ्गच्, and the radical vowel changed to the Vṛddhi form.

m. (-कः)
Woody Cassia.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ना)
A lovely woman.
E.
वर best, अङ्गना a woman.

f. (-ना)
A harlot.
E.
वार, and अङ्गना a woman.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Handsome and well-shaped.
E.
वराङ्ग excellent body, रूप form, and उपेत invested, possessing.

mfn. subst. (-टकः-टिका-टकं)
1 A rope, a cord, a string.
2 The small shell, called a Cowri, and used as a coin.
3 The seed-vessel of the lotus.
m. (-टिका)
The Nagesara plant.
E.
वृञ् to surround, aff. अटच्, and कन् added.

m. (-जाः)
A plant, commonly Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea).

m. (-म्रः)
An acid fruit, (Carissa Carondas.)
E.
वर best, अम्र acid.

n. (-कं)
The diamond.
E.
वर best, ऋ to go or be, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 An elephant-driver.
2 Mounting, riding.
3 A rider on an elephant or horse.
f. (-हा)
1 A handsome or elegant woman.
2 The hip or flank.
E.
वर excellent, आरोह mounting, &c.

m. (-कः)
The Caronda fruit, (Carissa Carondas.)
E.
वर best, अल to be equal to, वुन् aff.

m. (-लिः)
1 The moon.
2 A division of music.

f. (-का)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
वर best, supreme, आलि a female friend, कन् added.

m. (-शिः)
Coarse cloth.
E.
वर covering, अश to pervade, aff. इन्; also वरासि.

m. (-सिः)
1 Coarse cloth.
2 A swordsman.
f. (-सी)
Dirty clothes.
E.
वर covering, अस to be, aff. इन् and ङीप्.

m. (-शिः)
The ocean.
E.
वार्, and राशि quantity.

n. (-नं)
1 A cistern, a reservoir.
2 The China rose.
m. (-नः)
1 A whoremonger.
2 A door-keeper.
E.
वर best, &c., आसन seat.

n. (-नं)
A large water jar, a cistern, a reservoir.
E.
वार् water, आसन place of abiding.

m. (-हः)
1 A hog.
2 A name of VIṢṆU in the third Avatāra or descent, in which he assumed the shape of a boar.
3 A mountain.
4 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
5 A sort of measure.
6 One of the eighteen smaller Dvīpas or divisions of the universe.
E.
वर best, हन to injure, with आङ् prefix, and ड aff.

mfn. (-हः-ही-हं)
Relating to a boar, belonging to, derived from, &c.
f. ही
1 An esculent root, a Yam, (Dioscorea.)
2 One of the divine mothers.
3 A measure.
4 The earth.
5 A sow.
E.
वराह a hog or VIṢṆU, &c., अण् aff., and ङीप् fem. form.

f. (-न्ता)
A sort of yam.
E.
वराह a hog, and कान्ता beloved; also वराही.

m. (-ली)
A flower, (Helianthus annuns.)

f. (-न्ता)
A plant, a sort of sensitive plant according to some authorities, but to others, a kind of moss, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.); it is also considered sometimes, but erroneously, as synonymous with वराही Dioscorea.
E.
वराह a hog, and क्रान्त passing.

m. (-मा)
An esculent root: see वाराही.
E.
वराह a hog, and नामन् a name.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Served, honoured, adored, as a deity or spiritual teacher.
E.
वरिवस्या service, इतच् aff., and य optionally rejected.

f. (-स्या)
Service, honour, especially such devoted obedience as a pupil pays his spiritual preceptor.
E.
वरिवस indeclinable, here said to imply veneration, and क्याच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Served, adored.
E.
वरिवस्या as above, and इतच् aff.

f. (-शी)
A fish-hook.
E.
see वडिशी, ड, and र being interchanged.

n. (-षं)
A year.
m. plu. (-षाः)
The rains or rainy season.
E.
वृष to sprinkle, aff. इषन्.

m. (-शः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
वारि water, शीङ्^1 to sleep, aff. ड.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320. note: cf root SI in WIL.

m. (-शः)
The ocean.
E.
वार water, and ईश lord.

m. (-यः)
The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)
E.
वरिषा the rainy season, and प्रिय fond of; being supposed to drink rain water only.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Largest, greatest, most large.
2 Heaviest, mightiest.
3 Best, dearest, most preferable or beloved.
n. (-ष्ठं)
1

Copper.
2

Pepper.
m. (-ष्ठः)
The Francoline partridge.
E.
वर् substituted for उरु large, or वरु best, and इष्ठन्. affix of the irr. superlative.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Very large, largest, most large.
2 Best, most preferable or excellent.
3 Extremely young, tender, infantine.
m. (-यान्)
The eighteenth of the astronomical periods called Yogas.
E.
वर best, or substituted for उरु, and इयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.

m. (-र्द्दः)
An ox or bull.
E.
see वलीवर्द्द, ब and ल being changed to व and र; also वलीवर्द्द.

m. (-षुः)
KĀMA or CUPID.
E.
वृ to choose, ईषुन् aff.

m. (-णः)
1 VARUṆA, the deity of the waters and regent of the west.
2 Water or the ocean.
3 A tree, (Tapia cratoeva, or Capparis trifoliata.)
4 A name of the sun, or rather of one of the twelve forms of that luminary, or Ādityas.
E.
वृ to enclose (the earth), or वृ to select or prefer, being chosen by the gods for his office, and उनन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-जा)
Spirituous liquor.
E.
वरुण VARUṆA or the ocean personified, and आत्मजा daughter; being amongst the precious things produced at the churning of the ocean.

f. (-नी)
The wife of VARUṆA.
E.
वरुण, with ङीप् aff. and आनुक् augment.

n. (-त्रं)
An upper and outer garment.
E.
वृ to cover, उत्र Uṇādi aff.

m. (-थः)
A sort of wooden fender or ledge round a carriage, as a defence from the effects of collision.
n. (-थं)
1 Armour, mail.
2 Leather, skin.
3 A house or dwelling.
E.
वृ to surround, Uṇādi aff. ऊथन्.

m. (-थी)
1 A guard, a defender.
2 A car.
f. (-नी)
An army.
E.
वरूथ part of a car, इनि and ङीप् affs.

m. (-णः)
A wasp.

ind.
Frequently, repeatedly.
E.
वार a time in the third case.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
Chief, principal, pre-eminent.
E.
वृ to select, Uṇādi aff. एण्य.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 A chief, a sovereign.
2 INDRA.
f. (-न्द्री)
Ancient Gaur, the capital and district so named.
E.
वर best, इन्द्र chief, and with ङीप् aff.; the favorite country of the deity, &c.

m. (-रः)
ŚIVA.
E.
वर best, principal, ईश्वर lord.

m. (-टः)
A plant, commonly Marüa.

mf. (-लः-ली)
A wasp.
E.
वृ to cover, ओलच् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्; the fem. form may also mean, a smaller kind of wasp.

mf. (-रः-री)
Any young animal.
m. (-रः)
1 A lamb.
2 A goat.
3 Pleasure, pastime, sport, mirth, festivity.
E.
वृक to take, aff. अरन्.

m. (-टः)
1 A side glance, a wink, a leer.
2 The rays of the meridian sun.
mn. (-टः-टं)
The marks of a lover's finger nails on the bosom of a woman.
E.
वर्कर a young animal, अट to be or resemble, aff. अच्.

m. (-टः)
A pin, a bolt.

n. (-र्गः)
A class, a tribe, a multitude of similar things, whether animate or inanimate; as Ka-verga, the class of guttural letters; Tri-verga, a class of three (objects, as love, duty, and wealth); the Śūdra-varga, the Śūdra tribe.
2 A chapter, a book, a section.
3 A square number, (in arithmetic.)
E.
वृज to quit, to except (any thing else), aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
The square of a cube.
E.
वर्ग, and घन a cube.

n. (-लं)
A square root.
E.
वर्ग, and मूल a root.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Belonging to a class, a tribe, &c.
E.
वर्ग, and छ aff.

r. 1st cl. (वर्घति)
To go.

r. 1st cl. (वर्च्चते)
To shine.
r. 10th cl. (वर्च्चयति)
1 To cut.
2 To fill.

f. (-टी)
1 A kind of rice.
2 A harlot.

n. (-र्च्चः)
1 Form, figure, shape.
2 Light, lustre.
3 Ordure, fæces.
m. (-र्च्चाः)
The son of CANDRA.
E.
वर्च्च to shine, असुन् aff.

mn. (-स्कः-स्कं)
Fæces, excrement.
E.
वर्च to shine, असुन् aff., and कन् depreciative aff. added.

mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि)
Bright, glorious.
E.
वर्च्चस, and विन् aff.

mfn. (-र्ज्जः-र्ज्जा-र्ज्जं)
1 Free from, devoid of.
2 Excepted.
m. (-र्ज्जः)
1 Leaving, abandoning.
2 Excepting.
E.
वृज to abandon, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what leaves, shuns, excepts, &c.
E.
वृज to quit, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Quitting, abandonment, shunning, avoiding.
2 Injury, hurting.
3 Killing.
E.
वृज to abandon, aff. ल्युट्.

ind.
1 Having shunned or avoided.
2 Having omitted, excepting, leaving out.
E.
वृज to quit, aff. क्त्वा.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Abandoned, avoided.
2

Given.
3

Excluded, excepted.
E.
वृज to quit, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Improper, censurable, wicked, proper to be avoided.
2 Irregular, to be excepted.
E.
वृज to quit, and अनीयर् aff. of the future participle.

mfn. (-र्ज्ज्यः-र्ज्ज्या-र्ज्ज्यं)
1 To be shunned.
2 To be excepted, excluded, left out.
n. (-र्ज्ज्यं)
A point in each lunar mansion during the passage of the moon, in which no business should be begun.
E.
वृज to quit, यत् aff.

r. 10th cl. (वर्णयति)
1 To colour, to paint, to dye.
2 To send or cast, to direct, to order.
3 To praise, to extol, to proclaim qualities.
4 To describe.
5 To spread or extend.
6 To grind or pound.
7 To make exertions.
8 To shine.

m. (-र्णः)
1 A tribe, a class, a caste, an order.
2 Colour, hue, tint.
3 Coloured cloth thrown over the back of an elephant, an elephant's housings.
4 Quality, property.
5 Fame, celebrity.
6

Praise.
7

Gold.
8

Religious observance.
9 The order or arrangement of a song or poem.
10 A musical mode.
11 Staining the body with coloured unguents.
12 Beauty, lustre.
13 Theatrical dress or embellishment.
mn. (-र्णः-र्णं)
1 Perfume for the person.
2 A letter of the alphabet.
3 Form, figure.
4 Sort, kind.
5 Touch, the purity of gold, as ascertained by its streak on the touch-stone.
6 In arithmetic, a co-efficient.
n. (-र्णं)
Saffron.
f. (-र्णा)
A leguminous shrub, (Cytisus cajan.)
E.
वर्ण to paint, &c., aff. अच् or घञ्, or वृ to cover or screen, Uṇādi aff. नक्.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 Perfume for the person, especially pounded or ground.
2 Sandal.
mf. (-कः-का)
A paint, a pigment, as indigo, orpiment, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A panegyrist, a bard, a poetical encomiast, by tribe and profession.
2 A circle, an orb.
f. (-का)
Touch, standard, fineness or purity of gold.
E.
वण to colour, &c., ण्वुल् aff., or वर्ण as above, कन् added.

m. (-विः)
The son of KUVERA.
